schema.operations[].name: declared operation symbol, taken from preludeSrc and then from each built-in module registry source, in declaration order
schema.operations[].module: the built-in module whose import declares this operation; absent for a prelude declaration
schema.operations[].types: every declared type, one list entry per get-type result, measured
schema.operations[].masks: per declared arrow: parameter types with evaluated flags and the result; a parameter is unevaluated when declared Atom/Expression/Variable or the (:Atom T)/(:Expression T) quadrant
schema.operations[].zeroArityProbe: the transcript line of !(<op>) measured under a timeout; the zero-argument error text where the operation has one

derivation: scripts/gen-stdlib-manifest.py: operation list extracted from preludeSrc and from the built-in module registry in Minimal/Interpreter.lean; every field measured on ./.lake/build/bin/LeaTTa, a built-in module operation behind its own import
